settings.title: Settings layout
settings.subtitle: Section index with scroll-spy, setting rows and a summary rail.
settings.profileDesc: How you appear to people you share computers with.
settings.notificationsDesc: Choose what reaches you and where.
settings.dangerDesc: This removes the account and every computer in it.
field.name: Display name

dash.subtitle: Widgets pack densely; the last row fills to the end.

wizard.title: Wizard layout
wizard.subtitle: Stepper, one step body and a summary rail.
wizard.note: A note under the step, above the footer row: a refusal or an outcome that is not known yet.

gfaq.title: FAQ layout
gfaq.subtitle: A Questions section at the bottom of the page; links to its questions on the page and in a dialog.
gfaq.rate.a: Five percent of what each referral pays, for as long as they stay.
gfaq.hold.a: A payout is held for 60 days after the purchase, so a refund can still be taken back from it.
gfaq.count.a: Any delivered server purchase counts, if some of what was paid by card or crypto remains unrefunded.
gfaq.dialog.title: Join the program?
gfaq.dialog.body: You can leave at any time.
settings.keysDesc: Keys that let a terminal sign in as you.
settings.keysInfo: A key stays on this account until you remove it; computers read it when they start.
settings.keysOld: One key is more than a year old. Replace it when you can.
settings.keysNote: A removed key stops working on every computer at its next start.
